title: Prevent workflow telemetry failures from failing the workflow
summary: WorkflowPostProcess telemetry failures no longer cause the entire workflow to fail, allowing GitHub API errors during finalization to remain visible in logs without blocking successful builds.
key_points: Added continue-on-error: true to the WorkflowPostProcess telemetry step
Telemetry collection failures no longer propagate as workflow failures
Build and test status checks remain unaffected by telemetry errors
Updated regression checks and documentation to reflect the behavior change
Validated with 9 targeted tests on multiple PowerShell versions
